WF-02, step 1b — gate CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR on the design of REQ-107 (docs/design/REQ-107-e2e-team-web.md), pass 1 of at most 3. Run the earlier tests after the replacement table (section 12: E2K-25, E2K-41, E2K-50, E2K-60, the whole kit and starter test files, exec-docs and exec-scripted-source) with your own sketch of the changes. Any item not passed is a FAIL, there is no partial credit. Task text and your report hold no absolute machine paths, no temporary paths and no names of other projects of the owner.
